A professional rider in horse races
solution:

• The word **"Jockey"** refers to a **professional rider in horse races. **(घुड़दौड़ सवार)

 
 
• **Example:** The** jockey** skillfully guided his horse to victory in the derby.
 
• **Example:** The winning** jockey **has proved a controversial character, but is brilliant in the saddle

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Stuntman** (स्टंटमैन): A professional who performs daring acts, usually for movies.

 
 
• **Example:** The **stuntman** jumped from a high building without any fear.
 
 
 
• **Southpaw** (बायां हाथ): A term used to describe a left-handed person, especially in sports like boxing.
 
 
• **Example:** The **southpaw** boxer had a unique advantage in the ring.
 
 
 
• **Batsman** (बल्लेबाज): A player who bats in cricket.
 
 
• **Example:** The** batsman** scored a century in the match, leading his team to victory.
